blocks.text: Ionizing radiation: zyada energy wali radiation, jaise X rays aur gamma rays, bohat mutagenic (mutation paida karne wali) hain. Yeh atoms ko free radicals mein badal deti hain jo DNA strand ke phosphodiester bonds (nucleotides ko jorne wale bonds) tor sakte hain.

Ultraviolet radiation: DNA UV radiation ko zor se jazb (absorb) karta hai. Jab saath saath wale do pyrimidine nucleotides (C aur T) UV jazb karte hain to un ke darmiyan covalent bonds ban jate hain (kitab ise double covalent bond kehti hai). Is se replication bilkul ruk sakti hai.

Bohat si point mutations mutagen chemicals se hoti hain. Kuch chemicals nucleotides jaise hote hain aur DNA mein shamil ho jate hain; aisa DNA theek se transcribe nahin hota. Kuch chemicals adenine ya cytosine se amino group hata dete hain jis se woh ghalat jore banate hain (mis-pair), aur kuch nucleotides par hydrocarbon groups laga dete hain, jis se bhi ghalat jore bante hain. Aise mutagen chemicals laboratories mein aam istemal hote hain aur kabhi mahol mein bhi chhoot jate hain (maslan mustard gas).

Bohat si point mutations khud ba khud hoti hain. Kabhi nucleotides khud hi apni doosri shakal (alternative position) mein chale jate hain; replication mein DNA polymerase is badle hue nucleotide ke saamne ghalat nucleotide laga deta hai. Kabhi homologous chromosomes ke jorne par nucleotide sequences theek seedh mein nahin aate; aik strand ka hissa loop (chhalla) bana kar bahar nikal aata hai. Cell yeh loop kaat deta hai, aur aik chromosome se kai sau nucleotides kam (delete) ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Insanon mein chhoti mutations
blocks.text:
Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs): aik nucleotide ki tabdeeli. Yeh bohat aam hain; bezarar bhi ho sakti hain aur halka asar bhi daal sakti hain. Maslan gene mein aik base ki tabdeeli se insan doodh (lactose) hazam karne ke qabil nahin rehta.
Insertions aur deletions: aik ya zyada nucleotides ka barhna ya kam hona. Maslan Cystic Fibrosis ki aam wajah aik gene mein sirf teen nucleotides ka deletion hai; is se aik khaas amino acid nikal jata hai, protein theek se fold nahin hota (murta nahin), aur phephron aur hazme ke masail hote hain.
Silent mutations: protein ke amino acids ki tarteeb nahin badalti. Maslan mRNA codon GGC se GGU ho jaye (DNA mein GGC se GGT): genetic code ki degeneracy ki wajah se dono glycine hi dete hain.
Missense mutations: sirf aik amino acid badalta hai, jo protein ka kaam mutasir kar sakta hai. Maslan haemoglobin ke gene mein aik nucleotide ki tabdeeli (A se T) se glutamic acid ki jagah valine aa jata hai. Yeh aik "ghalat" amino acid red blood cells ki gol shakal bigaar deta hai aur sickle cell anaemia hota hai.
Nonsense mutations: protein ke sequence mein waqt se pehle stop codon aa jata hai, is liye protein chhota aur bekaar banta hai. Maslan Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy mein nonsense mutation gene ke beech mein stop signal bana deti hai; protein bohat chhota ban kar kaam nahin karta aur muscles dheere dheere kamzor hote jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab silent mutation ki misaal mein likhti hai ke "DNA code" GGC se GGU ho gaya. Lekin U (uracil) sirf RNA mein hota hai, is liye GGC aur GGU mRNA ke codons hain. DNA (coding strand) mein yeh tabdeeli GGC se GGT hogi. mRNA ke dono codons GGC aur GGU glycine dete hain, is liye silent mutation ki misaal baqi durust hai.

blocks.title: Zyada tar mutations nuqsandeh kyun?
blocks.text:
Zyada tar mutations genes ka normal kaam bigaar deti hain aur nuqsandeh saabit hoti hain, maslan:
• Haemoglobin protein mein sirf aik amino acid badalne wali mutation sickle cell anaemia kar sakti hai, jo kamzor kar dene wali aur jaan lewa bhi ho sakti hai.
• Mutations gene regulation bigaar kar jism ki nashonuma (development) badal sakti hain aur cancer jaisi bimariyon ka sabab ban sakti hain.
• Kuch mutations bekaar ya kamzor (unstable) proteins banati hain jo jandar ke liye nuqsandeh hain, maslan phenylketonuria.
